> Per-term tags govern assertion inside this page: a GROUNDED term may be asserted even though the page is draft overall. Definitional failures anywhere in the company route here; ontology comes first.

## Terms

| Term | Definition | Tag |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Customer | A paying account with an active subscription. Free workspaces are users. | GROUNDED |
| Logo / Deployment | A logo is one customer; a deployment is one workspace. One logo may have many deployments. Headline counts name which they count. | GROUNDED |
| Workspace | One connected storefront with its own event stream and users. | GROUNDED |
| Event model | The schema of shopper events (view, add to cart, checkout, purchase, return) with e-commerce properties. | GROUNDED |
| Activation | Three definitions in use: first dashboard viewed; first funnel saved; first shared report. [YOU DECIDE] Product owner must choose one; until then agents label it unconfirmed. | GENERIC |
| Net-new ARR | Defined in the Metrics Catalog, row R-01. This page holds no formula. | GROUNDED |
| Qualified pipeline | Opportunities at stage 2 or later with a confirmed budget owner. [CONFIRM] with RevOps whether stage 2 or stage 3 is the threshold. | GENERIC |

## Rules

- Metric formulas never live here; they live in the Metrics Catalog with a pull method.
- A term with a GENERIC tag is best-available, not truth. Agents say so in the sentence.
